title: Nearness of God
definition: The nearness of God is His gracious closeness to those who call on Him, especially the brokenhearted, humble, and repentant.
summary: God is near to those who seek Him, suffer before Him, and call on Him in truth.
christFocus: Jesus draws near to sinners and sufferers, bringing the presence and compassion of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is not distant from those who call on Him in truth. Scripture especially emphasizes His nearness to the brokenhearted, contrite, humble, and needy.

This nearness is not earned by emotional intensity. It is God's gracious presence with those who turn to Him. In Christ, the Holy God comes near to save and restore.

The nearness of God comforts suffering people and calls wandering people to return.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Pain and shame can make people think God is far away. The nearness of God matters because it invites the weary and repentant to draw near rather than hide.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Draw near to God honestly. Bring Him grief, sin, fear, and weakness, trusting that He receives those who come through Christ.
